name: retry
note: Level 1 only. It retries when the query fails to EXECUTE and is structurally unable to notice a query that ran and returned the wrong number — which is what A -> B is here to show.

WITH eligible_orders AS (
    SELECT
        o.order_id,
        o.amount_minor,
        o.currency
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
      AND o.currency IN ('EUR', 'JPY')
      AND o.placed_at >= TIMESTAMP '2025-01-01'
      AND o.placed_at < TIMESTAMP '2025-02-01'
),
refund_totals AS (
    SELECT
        r.order_id,
        SUM(
            r.amount_minor *
            CASE
                WHEN eo.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
                WHEN eo.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
                WHEN eo.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
            END
        ) AS refunds_usd
    FROM refunds r
    JOIN eligible_orders eo
      ON eo.order_id = r.order_id
    GROUP BY r.order_id
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(
        SUM(
            eo.amount_minor *
            CASE
                WHEN eo.currency = 'EUR' THEN 0.0108
                WHEN eo.currency = 'JPY' THEN 0.0067
                WHEN eo.currency = 'USD' THEN 0.01
            END
        ) - SUM(COALESCE(rt.refunds_usd, 0)),
        0
    ) AS net_revenue_usd
FROM eligible_orders eo
LEFT JOIN refund_totals rt
  ON rt.order_id = eo.order_id;

SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category,
    SUM(oi.qty) AS units_sold
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi
    ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
JOIN orders AS o
    ON o.order_id = oi.order_id
JOIN customers AS c
    ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
WHERE p.category = 'apparel'
  AND o.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
  AND c.is_internal = FALSE
  AND o.status <> 'cancelled'
GROUP BY
    p.product_id,
    p.category
ORDER BY units_sold DESC, p.product_id
LIMIT 5;

            WHEN 'EUR' THEN 0.0108

            WHEN 'USD' THEN 0.01
        END AS usd_factor
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c
      ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.deleted_at IS NULL
      AND c.is_internal = FALSE
      AND o.status <> 'cancelled'

    JOIN products p

)

FROM qualifying_orders qo
JOIN electronics_order_items eoi
  ON eoi.order_id = qo.order_id;
